Fusion Summon 1 DARK Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. During your Main Phase, if a card is in a Field Zone: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Earthbound" monster from your hand or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion or Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Earthbound Fusion" once per turn.

99628747.desc_fr: Vous pouvez Invoquer Rituellement cette carte avec une carte "Mégalithe". Vous pouvez défausser cette carte ; Invoquez Rituellement 1 Monstre Rituel "Mégalithe" depuis votre main, en Sacrifiant des monstres depuis votre main ou Terrain dont le Niveau total est supérieur ou égal à son Niveau. Si cette carte est Invoquée Rituellement : vous pouvez cibler un nombre de cartes contrôlées par votre adversaire, inférieur ou égal au nombre de Monstres Rituels de noms différents dans votre Cimetière ; détruisez-les. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chaque effet de "Bethor Mégalithe" qu'une fois par tour.
99628747.desc_en: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Megalith" card. You can discard this card; Ritual Summon 1 "Megalith" Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can target cards your opponent controls, up to the number of Ritual Monsters with different names in your GY; destroy them. You can only use each effect of "Megalith Bethor" once per turn.

99630221.desc_en: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that card when this card leaves the field. If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can send 1 Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Tigress in Silent Repose" once per turn.

99634927.desc_fr:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Abyss Actor" monster, then target 1 "Abyss Actor" monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster, until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field).

[ Monster Effect ] 
Si cette carte est Invoquée Normalement ou Spécialement : jusqu'à la fin de ce tour, vous pouvez faire gagner 300 ATK à cette carte pour chaque monstre "Acteur des Abysses" que vous contrôlez actuellement. Vous pouvez cibler 1 autre monstre "Acteur des Abysses" que vous contrôlez ; jusqu'à la fin de ce tour, il gagne une ATK égale à l'ATK actuelle de cette carte. Cette carte ne peut pas attaquer le tour où cet effet est activé. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Acteur des Abysses - Comédien Funky" qu'une fois par tour.
99634927.desc_en:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Abyss Actor" monster, then target 1 "Abyss Actor" monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster, until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field).

[ Monster Effect ] 
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can make this card gain 300 ATK for each "Abyss Actor" monster you currently control, until the end of this turn. You can target 1 other "Abyss Actor" monster you control; it gains ATK equal to this card's current ATK, until the end of this turn. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated. You can only use this effect of "Abyss Actor - Funky Comedian" once per turn.

99641328.desc_fr: Lorsque cette carte est retournée face recto : vous pouvez choisir un nombre entre 1 à 5, puis dévoilez ce nombre de cartes du dessus de votre Deck, envoyez les monstres de Type Plante dévoilés au Cimetière, et aussi, placez les autres cartes au-dessous de votre Deck dans l'ordre de votre choix. Si cette carte est dévoilée depuis le Deck et envoyée au Cimetière par un effet de carte : vous pouvez cibler 1 Carte Magie/Piège sur le Terrain ; détruisez la cible.
99641328.desc_en: When this card is flipped face-up: You can choose a number from 1 to 5, then excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, send any excavated Plant-Type monsters to the Graveyard, also place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. If this card is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

99645428.desc_fr: Meilleure amie de Lazuli, cette soldate se soucie profondément du bien-être de ses amis.
99645428.desc_en: The best of friends with Lazuli, this soldier deeply cares about the well-being of her friends.

99657399.desc_fr: Lorsque votre adversaire gagne des Life Points : ciblez 1 monstre contrôlé par votre adversaire ; détruisez la cible.
99657399.desc_en: When your opponent gains Life Points: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

99659159.desc_fr: Chaque monstre que vous contrôlez, qui est équipé avec un ou plusieurs monstres "Dragunité", gagne 500 points d'ATK. Une fois par tour, vous pouvez sélectionner 1 monstre face recto que vous contrôlez et l'équiper avec 1 monstre "Dragunité" de Type Dragon depuis votre main.
99659159.desc_en: Each monster you control that is equipped with a "Dragunity" monster(s) gains 500 ATK. Once per turn, you can select 1 face-up monster you control, and equip it with 1 Dragon-Type "Dragunity" monster from your hand.

99666430.desc_fr:
2 monstres de Niveau 6
Vous pouvez détacher 1 Matériel de cette carte, puis ciblez 1 monstre face recto contrôlé par votre adversaire ; prenez-en le contrôle jusqu'à la End Phase, mais il ne peut ni activer ses effets ni déclarer d'attaque. Si un Piège est sur le Terrain : vous pouvez Sacrifier 1 monstre, et si vous le faites, détruisez 1 carte face recto sur le Terrain. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chaque effet de "Jinzo - Superposé" qu'une fois par tour.
99666430.desc_en:
2 Level 6 monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase, but it cannot activate its effects or declare an attack. If a Trap is on the field: You can Tribute 1 monster, and if you do, destroy 1 face-up card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Jinzo - Layered" once per turn.

99668578.desc_fr: Si cette carte est Invoquée : vous pouvez envoyer 1 monstre "tellchevalier" depuis votre main au Cimetière, et si vous le faites, piochez 1 carte. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Satellchevalier Procyon" qu'une fois par tour.
99668578.desc_en: If this card is Summoned: You can send 1 "tellarknight" monster from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Satellarknight Procyon" once per turn.

99674361.desc_fr: Ciblez 1 monstre dans votre Cimetière ; Invoquez-le Spécialement dans votre zone pointée par un Monstre Lien. Vous ne pouvez activer qu'1 "Succession de l'Héritage du Monde" par tour.
99674361.desc_en: Target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone a Link Monster points to. You can only activate 1 "World Legacy Succession" per turn.

99675356.desc_fr: Lorsque cette carte est détruite au combat et envoyée au Cimetière : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 monstre "Six Samouraïs" de max. Niveau 3 depuis votre Deck.
99675356.desc_en: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower "Six Samurai" monster from your Deck.

99690140.desc_fr: Les dommages de combat que cette carte inflige à votre adversaire sont traités comme des dommages d'effet à la place.
99690140.desc_en: Any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is treated as effect damage instead.

99707692.desc_en: During your Main Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 "Raidraptor" monster you control; add 1 "Raidraptor" monster with a different Level than that monster from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; increase or decrease the Levels of all "Raidraptor" monsters you currently control by 1. You can only use each effect of "Raidraptor - Noir Lanius" once per turn.

99721536.desc_fr: Vous pouvez Invoquer Rituellement cette carte avec "Résurrection de Dokurorider".
99721536.desc_en: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Revival of Dokurorider". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

99724761.desc_fr:
"Tête de Canon X" + "Tank de Métal Z"
Doit d'abord être Invoquée Spécialement (depuis votre Extra Deck) en bannissant les cartes ci-dessus que vous contrôlez. (N'utilisez pas "Polymérisation".) Non Invocable Spécialement depuis le Cimetière. Vous pouvez défausser 1 carte, puis ciblez 1 Magie/Piège face verso contrôlé par votre adversaire ; détruisez la cible.
99724761.desc_en:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Z-Metal Tank"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

99726621.desc_fr:
2+ monstres Bête, Bête-Guerrier et/ou Bête Ailée
Si cette carte est Invoquée Spécialement, ou si un ou plusieurs autres monstres Bête, Bête-Guerrier ou Bête Ailée sont Invoqués Spécialement sur votre Terrain : vous pouvez bannir 1 carte sur le Terrain. Si cette carte est envoyée au Cimetière : vous pouvez ajouter 1 monstre Bête, Bête-Guerrier ou Bête Ailée depuis votre Deck à votre main, dont le Niveau est inférieur ou égal au nombre de vos monstres Bête, Bête-Guerrier et Bête Ailée bannis. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chaque effet de "Shuraig Tri-Brigade du Mauvais Augure" qu'une fois par tour.
99726621.desc_en:
2+ Beast, Beast-Warrior, and/or Winged Beast monsters
If this card is Special Summoned, or if another Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field: You can banish 1 card on the field. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster from your Deck to your hand, whose Level is less than or equal to the number of your banished Beast, Beast-Warrior, and Winged Beast monsters. You can only use each effect of "Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen" once per turn.

99733359.desc_fr: Durant le calcul des dommages, si un monstre de votre adversaire attaque tant que cette carte est dans votre Cimetière : vous pouvez payer 1000 LP ; Invoquez Spécialement cette carte, et si vous le faites, vous ne recevez aucun dommage de combat de ce combat, mais bannissez cette carte lorsqu'elle quitte le Terrain (ceci est un Effet Rapide). Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Stégocyber" qu'une fois par tour.
99733359.desc_en: During damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks while this card is in your Graveyard: You can pay 1000 LP; Special Summon this card, and if you do, you take no battle damage from that battle, but banish this card when it leaves the field (this is a Quick Effect). You can only use this effect of "Stegocyber" once per turn.

99735427.desc_fr: Annulez tous les effets de monstre TÉNÈBRES activés sur le Terrain ou dans le Cimetière.
99735427.desc_en: Negate all DARK monster effects activated on the field or in the Graveyard.

99742859.desc_en: You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower monsters from your Deck with the same Type, Attribute, and Level as each other (1 Normal Monster and 1 Effect Monster), but their effects are negated, also destroy them during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Rescue Hedgehog" once per turn.

99745551.desc_fr: Vous pouvez révéler cette carte dans votre main ; votre adversaire choisit 1 carte au hasard depuis toute votre main, puis vous défaussez la carte choisie. Puis, si la carte défaussée n'était pas "Danger !? Tsuchinoko ?", Invoquez Spécialement 1 "Danger !? Tsuchinoko ?" depuis votre main, et si vous le faites, piochez 1 carte. Si cette carte est défaussée : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement cette carte. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Danger !? Tsuchinoko ?" qu'une fois par tour.
99745551.desc_en: You can reveal this card in your hand; your opponent randomly chooses 1 card from your entire hand, then you discard the chosen card. Then, if the discarded card was not "Danger!? Tsuchinoko?", Special Summon 1 "Danger!? Tsuchinoko?" from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card. If this card is discarded: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Danger!? Tsuchinoko?" once per turn.

99747800.desc_fr: Une fois par tour, durant votre Standby Phase : cette carte gagne 700 ATK.
99747800.desc_en: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 700 ATK.

99748883.desc_en: During the Battle Phase, if 5 or more attacks have been declared this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Meteor Rush - Monochroid" once per turn. If this card battles, it gains 1000 ATK for each attack declared this turn, during the Damage Step only.

99753860.en: Ars Magna the Division and the Union
99753860.desc_en: You can banish this card from your hand; Special Summon 1 non-Spellcaster "Ars Magna" monster from your GY or banishment, also your "Power Patron" Link Monsters can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. If a Synchro or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can banish 1 "Ars Magna" card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Division and the Union" once per turn.

99785935.desc_fr: Alpha, Bêta et Gamma fusionnent pour former un monstre puissant.
99785935.desc_en: ''Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.''

99788587.desc_fr: Activable uniquement lorsque toutes les zones (4) de la colonne de cette carte sont occupées. Détruisez toutes les cartes de cette colonne.
99788587.desc_en: Activate only when all zones of this card's column are occupied. Destroy all cards in this column.

99789342.desc_fr: Payez la moitié de vos LP ; Invoquez Spécialement 1 "Magicien Sombre" depuis votre Deck. Vous ne pouvez pas Invoquer d'autres monstres le tour où vous activez cette carte (mais vous pouvez Poser Normalement).
99789342.desc_en: Pay half your LP; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your Deck. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

99792080.fr: Phantasos, l'Ennemi du Miroir des Rêves
99792080.desc_fr: Si cette carte est Invoquée Spécialement par l'effet d'un monstre "Miroir des Rêves" : cette carte peut attaquer directement ce tour. Durant la Main ou Battle Phase, si "Miroir des Rêves de la Joie" est dans une Zone Terrain (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez Sacrifier cette carte ; Invoquez Spécialement 1 "Phantasos, l'Ami du Miroir des Rêves" depuis votre Deck. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chaque effet de "Phantasos, l'Ennemi du Miroir des Rêves" qu'une fois par tour.
99792080.desc_en: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Dream Mirror" monster: This card can attack directly this turn. During the Main or Battle Phase, if "Dream Mirror of Joy" is in a Field Zone (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Friend" from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Foe" once per turn.

99795159.desc_fr: Les monstres ne peuvent pas attaquer les monstres en Position de Défense face verso, mais ils peuvent attaquer directement si tous les monstres contrôlés par leur adversaire sont en Position de Défense face verso. Tous les dommages d'effet et dommages de combat infligés par des monstres (monstres "Fantôruse" exclus) sont divisés par deux.
99795159.desc_en: Monsters cannot attack face-down Defense Position monsters, but can attack directly if all monsters their opponent controls are face-down Defense Position. All effect damage, and battle damage inflicted by monsters other than "Ghostrick" monsters, is halved.

99801464.desc_en: (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card from your hand or field to it. It gains 100 ATK/DEF. You can only use this effect of "Sari of the Silverwing Axe" once per turn.

99861526.desc_fr: Cette carte peut attaquer directement votre adversaire, mais lorsqu'elle le fait en utilisant cet effet, les dommages de combat infligés à votre adversaire sont l'ATK d'origine de cette carte. À la fin de la Damage Step, si cette carte a attaqué ou a été attaquée : vous pouvez changer cette carte en Position de Défense.
99861526.desc_en: This card can attack your opponent directly, but when it does so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is the original ATK of this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can change this card to Defense Position.

99865167.desc_fr: Cette carte peut être traitée comme 2 Sacrifices pour faire l'Invocation Sacrifice d'un Monstre Normal VENT.
99865167.desc_en: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a WIND Normal Monster.

99877698.desc_fr: Vous pouvez Sacrifier 1 monstre "Protecteurs du Tombeau" ("Canonnier des Protecteurs du Tombeau" exclu) ; infligez 700 points de dommages à votre adversaire.
99877698.desc_en: You can Tribute 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster, except "Gravekeeper's Cannonholder"; inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

99885917.desc_fr: Si cette carte est Invoquée Normalement ou Spécialement : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 monstre "Marincesse" ("Pascalus Marincesse" exclu) depuis votre main en Position de Défense. Durant votre Main Phase, sauf le tour où cette carte a été envoyée au Cimetière : vous pouvez bannir cette carte depuis votre Cimetière, puis ciblez 1 Magie/Piège "Marincesse" dans votre Cimetière ; ajoutez-le à votre main. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chaque effet de "Pascalus Marincesse" qu'une fois par tour.
99885917.desc_en: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Marincess" monster from your hand in Defense Position, except "Marincess Pascalus". During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Marincess" Spell/Trap in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Pascalus" once per turn.

99890852.desc_fr: Ciblez 1 monstre "Farstar" que vous contrôlez et 1 monstre face recto sur le Terrain ; renvoyez le monstre "Farstar" à la main, et si vous le faites, l'autre monstre gagne une ATK égale à l'ATK d'origine du monstre renvoyé jusqu'à la fin de ce tour. Vous ne pouvez activer qu 1 "Bouquet Farstar" par tour.
99890852.desc_en: Target 1 "Trickstar" monster you control and 1 face-up monster on the field; return that "Trickstar" monster to the hand, and if you do, the other monster gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the returned monster, until the end of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Trickstar Bouquet" per turn.

99899504.desc_fr: Une fois par tour, vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 "Crâne Ardent" depuis votre main. Vous ne pouvez pas conduire votre Battle Phase le tour où vous activez cet effet. Vous pouvez ajouter 1 "Crâne Ardent" depuis votre Cimetière à votre main au lieu de mener une pioche normale durant votre Draw Phase.
99899504.desc_en: Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 "Burning Skull Head" from your hand. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect. You can add 1 "Burning Skull Head" from your Graveyard to your hand instead of conducting a normal draw in your Draw Phase.

99902789.desc_fr: Lorsque votre adversaire active une Carte Piège Normal en réponse à la déclaration d'attaque de votre monstre ciblant un monstre de votre adversaire : vous pouvez défausser cette carte ; annulez l'activation, et si vous le faites, détruisez la carte (ceci est un Effet Rapide).
99902789.desc_en: When your opponent activates a Normal Trap Card in response to your monster's attack declaration targeting an opponent's monster: You can discard this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card (this is a Quick Effect).

99910751.desc_fr: Le nom de cette carte devient "Mokey Mokey" et elle est traitée comme un Monstre Normal tant qu'elle est face recto sur le Terrain ou dans le Cimetière. Vous pouvez défausser cette carte ; ajoutez 1 carte "Mokey Mokey" ("Mokey Mokey à la Dérive" exclu) depuis votre Deck à votre main.
99910751.desc_en: This card's name becomes "Mokey Mokey" and is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the GY. You can discard this card; add 1 "Mokey Mokey" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Mokey Mokey Adrift".

99913726.desc_fr: Vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement cette carte (depuis votre main ou Cimetière) en Sacrifiant 1 monstre avec un Compteur Prédateur sur le Terrain de l'un des joueurs. Vous ne pouvez Invoquer Spécialement "Hydre Drosophyllum Prédaplante" qu'une fois par tour de cette façon. Si cette carte est sur le Terrain ou dans votre Cimetière (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez bannir 1 autre monstre "Prédaplante" depuis votre Cimetière, puis ciblez 1 monstre face recto sur le Terrain ; il perd 500 ATK. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Hydre Drosophyllum Prédaplante" qu'une fois par tour.
99913726.desc_en: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or GY) by Tributing 1 monster on either player's field with a Predator Counter. You can only Special Summon "Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra" once per turn this way. If this card is on the field or in your GY (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 other "Predaplant" monster from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 500 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra" once per turn.

99916754.desc_fr:
"Lion Naturia" + "Barkion Naturia"
L'Invocation Fusion de cette carte ne peut être faite qu'avec les Matériels Fusion ci-dessus. Lorsqu'une Carte Magie/Piège est activée (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez bannir 1 carte depuis votre Cimetière, puis envoyez la carte du dessus de votre Deck au Cimetière ; annulez l'activation, et si vous le faites, détruisez la carte. Cette carte doit être face recto sur le Terrain pour activer et résoudre cet effet.
99916754.desc_en:
"Naturia Beast" + "Naturia Barkion"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. While this card is face-up on the field, you can negate the activation of a Spell/Trap Card, and destroy it, by removing from play 1 card from your Graveyard, then sending the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.

99927991.desc_fr: Dévoilez un nombre de cartes du dessus de votre Deck égal au nombre de monstres Rocher que vous contrôlez +5, et si vous le faites, vous pouvez ajouter à votre main 1 monstre Rocher dévoilé de Niveau inférieur ou égal au nombre de cartes dévoilées, et aussi, placez les cartes restantes au-dessous de votre Deck dans l'ordre de votre choix. Le reste de ce tour après la résolution de cette carte, vous ne pouvez pas Invoquer Spécialement de monstres (monstres Rocher exclus).
99927991.desc_en: Excavate the top cards of your Deck equal to the number of Rock monsters you control +5, and if you do, you can add to your hand 1 excavated Rock monster with a Level equal to or lower than the number of the excavated cards, also place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except Rock monsters.

99937011.desc_en: You can discard 1 other EARTH Fairy monster; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can place 1 "Gravekeeper's Trap" from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your field or GY, then target up to 3 cards in any GY(s), or up to 5 if "Exchange of the Spirit" is on your field or in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Mudora the Sword Oracle" once per turn.

99937842.desc_fr:
1 Syntoniseur + 1+ monstre non-Syntoniseur "T.G."
Une fois par Chaîne, durant la Main Phase de votre adversaire, vous pouvez (Effet Rapide) : immédiatement après la résolution de cet effet, Invoquez par Synchronisation en utilisant cette carte que vous contrôlez. Vous ne pouvez utiliser chacun des effets suivants de "Gardien des Étoiles T.G." qu'une fois par tour.
●Si cette carte est Invoquée Spécialement : vous pouvez cibler 1 monstre "T.G." dans votre Cimetière ; ajoutez-le à votre main.
●Durant votre Main Phase : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 monstre "T.G." depuis votre main.
99937842.desc_en:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner "T.G." monsters
Once per Chain, during your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "T.G. Star Guardian" once per turn.
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 "T.G." monster in your GY; add it to your hand.
● During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "T.G." monster from your hand.

99940363.desc_fr: Si vous contrôlez un monstre avec min. 2400 ATK et 1000 DEF : ciblez 1 carte Posée sur le Terrain ; détruisez-la. Vous pouvez bannir cette carte et 1 Carte Magie/Piège "Monarque" depuis votre Cimetière, puis ciblez 1 carte Posée sur le Terrain ; détruisez-la.
99940363.desc_en: If you control a monster with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy it. You can banish this card and 1 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Set card on the field; destroy it.

99941223.desc_en: Fusion Summon 1 DARK Fairy Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing monsters from your hand, field, and/or GY as material. The monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 1000 ATK. If Summoning a "Darklord" Fusion Monster this way, you can also use "Darklord" monsters your opponent controls as material. You can only activate 1 "Darklord Dance" per turn.

99946920.en: Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing
99946920.desc_fr: Lorsque cette carte que vous contrôlez est détruite au combat ou par un effet de carte, et envoyée à votre Cimetière : vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 monstre "Yang Zing" ("Taotie, Ombre du Yang Zing" exclu) depuis votre Deck en Position de Défense. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cet effet de "Taotie, Ombre du Yang Zing" qu'une fois par tour. Une fois par tour, durant la Main Phase ou Battle Phase de votre adversaire, vous pouvez : immédiatement après la résolution de cet effet, Invoquez par Synchronisation 1 Monstre Synchro, en utilisant uniquement des monstres "Yang Zing" que vous contrôlez (ceci est un Effet Rapide). La possession d'un Monstre Synchro sur le Terrain qui a utilisé cette carte comme Matériel de Synchro ne peut pas changée.
99946920.desc_en: When this card you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Yang Zing" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing". You can only use this effect of "Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing" once per turn. Once per turn, during your opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster, using only "Yang Zing" monsters you control (this is a Quick Effect). Possession of a Synchro Monster on the field that used this card as a Synchro Material cannot switch.

99984170.desc_en:
(This card is always treated as a "Rescue-ACE" card.)
Target 1 "Rescue-ACE" monster in your GY, or if you control "Rescue-ACE Hydrant", you can target 1 monster in your opponent's GY instead; Special Summon it to your field. You can only activate 1 "RESCUE!" per turn.

99989863.desc_en: Target 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT Fiend monster you control; send all cards on the field to the GY that are not that monster. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; send 1 "Fiendsmith" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Fiendsmith in Paradise" once per turn.

99991455.desc_en:
1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT Warrior monster + 1 EARTH Warrior monster
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card battles a monster without a Level, any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is doubled. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed by battle or card effect and sent there this turn: You can target 2 Level 7 or lower Warrior monsters in your GY; Special Summon them. You can only use this effect of "Raijin the Breakbolt Star" once per turn.

99995595.desc_fr: Ciblez 2 monstres de Type Tonnerre avec max. 1500 ATK dans votre Cimetière ; ajoutez les cibles à votre main.
99995595.desc_en: Target 2 Thunder-Type monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

100000101.desc_en: Pay 1000 Life Points. Special Summon 1 "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" from your Graveyard.

100200298.desc_en:
During the Battle Phase: Activate 1 of these effects;
● When an opponent's monster declares an attack while they control more monsters than you do: Negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect: Negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that monster.
When you draw for your normal draw in your Draw Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.

100350263.en: The Dark Dragon Lord of Ultum
100350263.desc_en: ''A dragon from another star that awoke from within a sealed underground world. It's a well-known fact even in Dimension Zeta that when you first wake up, you can only exert one-thousandth of your true strength.''

100460001.desc_en: Once per turn, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either effect, except Fusion Monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 card; add up to 2 "Cubic" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand.

100460002.en: Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord
100460002.desc_en:
1 "Cubic" monster + "Vijam the Cubic Seed"
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards from your hand and/or field to the GY. Gains 800 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

100460003.en: Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord
100460003.desc_en:
3 "Cubic" monsters
Gains 1000 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 3 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

100460004.en: Divine Anima Infinity the Creation Cubic Overlord
100460004.desc_en:
4 "Cubic" monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 1500 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can shuffle all your banished "Cubic" cards into the Deck, and if you do, destroy 1 card your opponent controls. If this face-up card in its owner's control leaves the field by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon up to 3 "Vijam the Cubic Seed" from your GY.

100460006.desc_en: When this card is activated: You can send 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to the GY. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; place 1 Cubic Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls (monsters with a Cubic Counter cannot attack, also negate their effects). If a "Cubic" monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only activate 1 "Cubic Bodhi" per turn.

100461000.en: Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils
100461000.desc_en: If "Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye" or "Snake-Eyes Poplar" is in either GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn. You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela" from your GY; destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera" from your GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

100461001.en: Buster Blader, the One Who Surpasses the Limits
100461001.desc_en: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can discard 1 Spell; Special Summon this card, and if you do, its name becomes "Buster Blader", also banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Buster Blader, the One Who Surpasses the Limits" once per turn. Gains 500 ATK for each Attack Position monster your opponent controls. When this card destroys a monster by battle: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon that monster to your field.

100461002.desc_en: Each time an opponent's monster declares an attack, place 1 Sinister Doctrine Counter on this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Wicked Canon" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 DARK Fiend monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 Fiend monster. You can send this card with 4 or more Sinister Doctrine Counters to the GY; Special Summon 1 Fiend monster from your Deck, then you can add 1 "Super Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

100461003.desc_en: If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster or "Elemental HERO Neos": Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions a "HERO" monster as material, using monsters from your hand, Deck, or field. If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Hope for the Future" once per turn.

101206080.desc_en: Activate this card by placing 5 Celebration Counters on it. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, and/or a card(s) is sent from the Deck to the GY, by a Spell/Trap effect: Remove 1 Celebration Counter from this card, then, if there are no Celebration Counters on it, destroy it, and if you do, gain 4000 LP, then Set 1 "Celebration" Trap from your Deck or GY, then, if you have 1 or less cards in your Deck, you win the Duel.

101303071.desc_en: You cannot activate the following effects of "Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~" in the same Chain. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; move that monster you control to another of your Main Monster Zones. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card and you control 3 or more "Elvennotes" monsters: You can negate that effect, then if you control a Synchro Monster, you can destroy that card. You can only use this effect of "Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~" once per turn.

101303084.desc_en:
2+ Level 10 monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can attach 1 monster from your Deck to this card as material. You can only use this effect of "Mercurium the Living Quicksilver" once per turn. While this card has material, your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters in their GY with the same Attribute as a monster in your GY. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Detach 1 material from this card or take 3000 damage.

101304014.desc_en: (Quick Effect): You can send 1 other "Elvennotes" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned to the center Main Monster Zone: You can Special Summon 1 "Elvennotes" monster from your Deck, except "Elvennotes Regina". If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Elvennotes Regina" once per turn.

101402101.en: Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
101402101.desc_en: If 4 or more cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 2 Spells/Traps you control to the GY; draw that many cards, then you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-down Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn, all face-down cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. You can only use each effect of "Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse" once per turn.

101403001.en: Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God
101403001.desc_en: You can discard 1 other card; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God", then if your opponent's LP are at least 2000 higher than yours, you can discard 1 random card from their hand. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God" once per turn.

101403002.en: Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God
101403002.desc_en: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God" once per turn.

101403003.en: Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God
101403003.desc_en: If this card is in your hand and you control a "Sun God" card: You can Special Summon this card. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 other card in either GY; send 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, place the targeted card on the bottom of the Deck. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God" once per turn.

101403004.en: Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God
101403004.desc_en: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God" once per turn. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY and you control a "Sun God" card, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return 1 other card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck, and if you do that, inflict 800 damage to your opponent. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand.

101403009.en: Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest
101403009.desc_en: If you control a "Winter Raven" card, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" Spell/Trap or 1 "Sinful Spoils" card from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card or 1 Level 7 or 8 Monster Card in the Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it to your field.

101403010.en: Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven
101403010.desc_en: You can send 1 other card from your hand or field to the GY; place this card face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon up to 2 "Winter Raven" monsters with different names from each other from your Deck, except "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven". When a monster declares an attack and this card is a Continuous Spell: You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

101403011.en: Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven
101403011.desc_en: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Winter Raven" monster you control; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". You can only use each effect of "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

101403012.en: Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest
101403012.desc_en: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by placing 1 Level 1 FIRE Monster Card from your face-up field or GY on the bottom of the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the hand, then target 1 monster in the face-up field or either GY; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. You can only use this effect of "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn.

101403013.desc_en: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY as material for a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE Cyberse monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Markhor" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except FIRE monsters.

101403014.desc_en: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Salamangreat" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can increase or decrease the Level of 1 monster on the field by 1. If you Link Summon a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; Set 1 "Salamangreat" Trap from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Bastella" once per turn.

101403020.desc_en: You can send 1 Normal Monster with 2000 or less ATK from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Bunnillin" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY face-up on your field. If your opponent Special Summons an Effect Monster(s), while this card is in the Monster Zone: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Bunnillin: Mocha MOD" once per turn.

101403021.desc_en: When your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster, while this card is in your hand and your opponent has 4 or more monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set in their face-up field, GY, and/or banishment (Quick Effect): You can negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster, and if you do that, Special Summon this card (while you control no monsters, this effect and its activation cannot be negated). You can send this card from the field to the GY; halve the ATK of 1 monster on the field. You can only use each effect of "Heretic Eradicator" once per turn.

101403023.en: The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor
101403023.desc_en: During your opponent's End Phase: You can place this card from your GY on top of the Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can return this card from the field to the hand, and if you do, each player draws 1 card, then your opponent can draw 1 card, and if they do, you must keep your hand revealed during this Main Phase. (Quick Effect): You can banish this revealed card from your hand; destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor" once per turn.

101403024.desc_en: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 non-WIND "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Amurusa" once per turn.

101403025.desc_en: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 "Reindsurm" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Luvian" once per turn.

101403026.desc_en: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can send 2 "Reindsurm" cards from your Deck to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Carcasas" once per turn.

101403027.desc_en: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". (Quick Effect): You can send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, including this card; add 1 non-FIRE "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Ritual Summoned, or your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can shuffle up to 2 monsters on the field into the Deck. If this card and a WATER "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Gigalovendra" once per turn.

101403028.desc_en: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". When your opponent activates a monster effect in the field or GY and you control this Ritual Summoned card (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, then you can shuffle 1 monster each from both your opponent's field and GY into the Deck, also if either of them was a Dragon monster, double this card's ATK. If this card and a LIGHT "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Giriakarma" once per turn.

101403029.desc_en: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Javelin Beetle of the Alliance". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use this effect of "Javelin Beetle of the Alliance" once per Duel. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can target 1 other card in this card's column; destroy it, and if you do, this card gains 600 ATK.

101403030.en: The Winged Dragon of Ra, Sun God of Darkness
101403030.desc_en:
"The Winged Dragon of Ra" + 3 "Sun God" monsters
Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard any number of "Sun God" cards, then choose that many of your opponent's occupied Main Monster Zones; your opponent must send the monsters in those zones to the GY. When an attack is declared involving this card: You can pay LP so that you only have 1 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid and the total ATK of all "Sun God" monsters currently in your GY.

101403031.en: Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God
101403031.desc_en:
1 "Sun God" monster you control + 2 face-up monsters on the field
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) to your opponent's Main Monster Zone by sending the above cards from either field to the GY, but if you Special Summon this card with the second method, you can only Special Summon once for the rest of this turn. You can only Special Summon "Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

101403034.en: Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest
101403034.desc_en:
1 Fusion or Synchro Monster + 1 Spellcaster or Illusion monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can place any number of monsters you control face-up in their owners' Spell & Trap Zones as Continuous Spells, then you can return cards on the field to the hand up to the number of Spells/Traps you control. You can only use this effect of "Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. Gains 700 ATK/DEF for each Spell/Trap on the field. This face-up Fusion Summoned card cannot be used as Fusion Material.

101403037.en: Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven
101403037.desc_en:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck.
● Extra Deck: Add 1 "Winter Raven" card from your GY to your hand.
You can only use each effect of "Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

101403038.en: Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven
101403038.desc_en:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Target 1 card on the field; shuffle it into the Deck.
● Extra Deck: Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

101403040.desc_en:
1 Defense Position Tuner + 1+ Defense Position non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned in Attack Position: Change it to Defense Position. This Defense Position card gains these effects.
● Change all face-up monsters on the field to Defense Position.
● Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to the activation of their own cards or effects.
● Once per turn, during the End Phase: Each player gains 500 LP for each Defense Position monster they control.

101403044.en: Karin the Celestial Sage of the Highest Heights
101403044.desc_en:
2 Level 7 monsters
When your opponent activates a card or effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a monster(s) from the Deck (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; your opponent draws 1 card, then negate that activated effect, and if you do, destroy that card. During your Main Phase 2: You can target 1 Level 7 monster in your GY; take damage equal to its ATK, and if you do, return both it and this card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Karin the Celestial Sage of the Highest Heights" once per turn.

101403051.desc_en: Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your GY or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions, then if you Special Summoned "The Winged Dragon of Ra" by this effect, you can send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your Extra Deck. During the End Phase, send the monsters Special Summoned by this effect to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can discard 1 "Sun God" card; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Immortal Sun God" once per turn.

101403052.en: The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness
101403052.desc_en: Activate this card by sending 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 "Sun God" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is destroyed by battle: Its controller takes damage equal to its original ATK, then if you have "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your GY, you gain 1000 LP. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness" once per turn.

101403055.desc_en: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any number of Insect Ritual Monsters. You must also shuffle Insect and/or Dragon monsters from the GY(s) into the Deck whose total Levels equal or exceed the total Levels of the Ritual Monsters. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 Insect monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Conquest" once per turn.

101403056.desc_en: While you control a "Reindsurm" monster whose original Level is 8 or higher or your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, the activated effects of your "Reindsurm" monsters cannot be negated. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Reindsurm" monster or Dragon monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add 1 Insect monster from your Deck to your hand with the same original Level, but a different original name.

101403057.desc_en: Send 2 monsters from your Deck to the GY, including an Insect monster, also you cannot Special Summon until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, except Insect monsters. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; all "Reindsurm" monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK/DEF. You can only use 1 "Reindsurm Butterfly" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

101403058.desc_en: Add 2 "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then if your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, you can add 1 Insect monster from your GY to your hand. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; place 1 "Reindsurm" Field Spell from your Deck face-up on your field. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Practice" once per turn.

101403059.en: Deep Forest of the Winter Raven
101403059.desc_en: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your Deck to your hand. "Winter Raven" Monster Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect of "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" per turn.

101403063.desc_en: Special Summon 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your hand or GY, and if you do, equip this card to it. You can send 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your Deck to the GY; the equipped monster gains ATK equal to the sent monster's Level x 300. If this card is in your GY: You can shuffle 3 "Salamangreat" cards from your GY into the Deck, except Equip Spells, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Gearblade" once per turn.

101403066.desc_en: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Extract" once per turn. If a card(s) is sent from your opponent's Deck to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand or Deck. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.

101403068.desc_en: Send 1 Zombie Ritual Monster from your Deck to the GY; place 1 Field Spell from your Deck or GY face-up on your field, also you cannot activate non-Zombie monster effects for the rest of this turn after this card resolves. If your opponent controls an Effect Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Ritual Monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Pyramid of Kepher" once per turn.

101403069.desc_en:
You can banish (face-down) the top 5, 10, or 15 cards of your Deck, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; apply the appropriate effect to it.
● 5: Its ATK/DEF become 0.
● 10: Negate its effects.
● 15: Banish it (face-down).
You can only use this effect of "Card Crawl" once per turn.

101403071.desc_en: This card's name becomes "Summer" while in the Field Zone. Once per turn: You can place Season Counters on this card equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can take 1 Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY that you can place a Season Counter on, except "Autumn", and place it face-up on your field, and if you do, place all Season Counters on this card on that card. If a card(s) in the Field Zone would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

101403072.desc_en:
If a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster is on the field: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Special Summon 1 monster from each GY to your field.
● If "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is on the field, take control of all monsters your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY and Tribute 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster; gain LP equal to the ATK it had on the field. You can only use each effect of "Sun God Domination" once per turn.

101403073.en: Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God
101403073.desc_en:
Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 3000) with the following effects (this card is also still a Trap).
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster by this effect during your opponent's turn, you can Special Summon it.
● Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
You can only activate 1 "Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God" per turn.

101403076.desc_en: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Reindsurm" monster: Negate the activation, then you can add 1 "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand, and if you do, send 1 Insect monster you control to the GY. If a "Reindsurm" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can place this card from your GY on the bottom of the Deck instead. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Encounter" once per turn.

101403077.en: Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch
101403077.desc_en:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Diabell" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using up to 1 "Winter Raven" monster each from your hand, Extra Deck, and/or field.
● If you control a "Diabell" monster: Target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects until the end of this turn.
You can only use this effect of "Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch" once per turn.

101403078.en: Illusion of the Winter Raven Witch
101403078.desc_en: Fusion Summon 1 Illusion Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your Extra Deck and/or field, also you cannot activate monster effects in the hand or GY for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Illusion monsters'. If the activation of this card in its owner's possession was negated by an opponent's card effect and sent to your GY: You can Set this card, and if you do, return all cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only activate 1 "llusion of the Winter Raven Witch" per turn.

101403080.desc_en: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, Normal Monsters you control gain 1000 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Soft" once per turn. You can target 2 Normal Monsters in your GY with different Types, Attributes, and Levels; Special Summon them. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can add 1 card from your GY to your hand.

111000561.desc_en: You can only play this card if you were present at the 2007 Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME World Championship. The ATK of all your "Elemental Hero" and "Neo-Spacian" monsters on the field is doubled.

149694341.desc_en: This card is used as a placeholder in tournament deck profiles. The card(s) were intentionally left unrevealed by the player.

300101001.desc_fr: Une fois par tour, si vous contrôlez un monstre Zombie, vous pouvez placer 1 Compteur sur cette carte. Tous les monstres Zombie que vous contrôlez gagnent 100 ATK et perdent 100 DEF pour chaque Compteur sur cette carte. Les dommages de combat que vous recevez de combats impliquant votre monstre Zombie sont doublés.
300101001.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.] 

Once per turn, if you control a Zombie monster, you can place 1 counter on this card. All Zombie monsters you control gain 100 ATK and lose 100 DEF for each counter on this card. Any battle damage you take from battles involving your Zombie monster is doubled.

300101002.desc_fr: Tous les monstres Dinosaure, Zombie et Rocher sur le Terrain gagnent 200 ATK/DEF.
300101002.desc_en:
[At the start of the Duel, place this card in your Field Zone and flip it over.]

All Dinosaur, Zombie, and Rock monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

300101003.desc_en:
[At the start of the Duel, place this card in your center Spell & Trap Zone. You cannot activate this Skill during your first turn of the Duel. You draw 1 less card at the beginning of the Duel.] 

Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

300101004.desc_fr: Une fois par tour, si vous contrôlez "Chevalier de la Reine", vous pouvez payer 1000 LP pour Invoquer Normalement 1 "Chevalier du Roi" en plus de votre Invocation/Pose Normale. "Chevalier du Roi" et "Chevalier Valet" que vous contrôlez ne peuvent pas attaquer directement le tour où vous utilisez cette compétence.
300101004.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.]

Once per turn, if you control "Queen's Knight", you can pay 1000 LP to Normal Summon 1 "King's Knight" in addition to your Normal Summon or Set. "King's Knight" and "Jack's Knight" you control cannot attack directly the turn you use this Skill.

300101005.desc_fr:
Le nom de cette carte est toujours traité comme "Vallée Mortuaire".
Tous les monstres "Protecteurs du Tombeau" sur le Terrain gagnent 200 ATK/DEF.
300101005.desc_en:
[At the start of the Duel, place this card in your Field Zone and flip it over.]

This card's name is always treated as "Necrovalley".
All "Gravekeeper's" monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

300102001.desc_fr: Une fois par tour, vous pouvez payer 500 LP et défausser 1 monstre EAU, puis ajouter 1 monstre EAU depuis votre Cimetière à votre main, de nom différent et d'un Niveau inférieur au double du Niveau du monstre défaussé. Si vous faites ça, retournez cette carte.
300102001.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.]

Once per turn, you can pay 500 LP and discard 1 WATER monster, then add 1 WATER monster from your GY to your hand, with a different name and with a Level no more than twice the discarded monster's Level. If you do that, flip this card over.

300102002.desc_fr: Tous les monstres Poisson/Serpent de Mer/Tonnerre/Aqua sur le Terrain gagnent 200 ATK/DEF. Tous les monstres Machine et Pyro sur le Terrain perdent 200 ATK/DEF. Le nom de cette carte devient "Umi" tant qu'elle est sur le terrain.
300102002.desc_en:
[At the start of the Duel, place this card in your Field Zone and flip it over.]

All Fish, Sea Serpent, Thunder, and Aqua monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. All Machine and Pyro monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF. This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field.

300102003.desc_fr:
Si vous contrôlez "Le Pêcheur Légendaire", vous pouvez activer "Umi" directement depuis votre Deck ou Cimetière. Cette Compétence ne peut être utilisée qu'une fois par Duel. 
Une fois par tour, lorsque "Le Pêcheur Légendaire" que vous contrôlez détruit un monstre au combat ou inflige des dommages de combat à votre adversaire, vous pouvez Invoquer Spécialement 1 monstre EAU de max. Niveau 4 depuis votre Deck ou Cimetière en Position de Défense.
300102003.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.]

If you control "The Legendary Fisherman", you can activate "Umi" directly from your Deck or GY. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.
Once per turn, when "The Legendary Fisherman" you control destroys a monster by battle or inflicts battle damage to your opponent, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower WATER monster from your Deck or GY in Defense Position.

300102004.desc_fr: Lorsque vous activez un effet qui va vous faire lancer un ou plusieurs dés à six faces ou une ou plusieurs pièces, vous pouvez payer 1000 LP pour décider du résultat du lancer d'1 dé ou d'1 pièce. Cette Compétence ne peut être utilisée qu'une fois par Duel.
300102004.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill..]

When you activate an effect that would make you roll a six-sided die (or dice) or flip a coin(s), you can pay 1000 LP to decide the result of 1 die or coin. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

300102005.desc_fr: Une fois par tour, défaussez un nombre de votre choix de cartes et déclarez 1 type de carte (Monstre, Magie ou Piège). Votre adversaire envoie 1 carte du type déclaré depuis son Deck au Cimetière pour chaque carte défaussée. Si vous faites ça, retournez cette carte.
300102005.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.]

Once per turn, discard any number of cards and declare 1 type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap). Your opponent sends 1 card of the declared type from their Deck to the GY for each discarded card. If you do that, flip this card over.

300103001.desc_en: The first time each DARK Machine monster you control would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed, and if you took battle damage from the battle, it gains that much ATK after damage calculation, and keeps that ATK gain as long as this card is on the field. Once per turn, if a monster you control that was originally a DARK Machine destroys a card(s) on the field by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon 1 DARK Machine monster from your hand.

300103002.desc_fr: Activez cette Compétence durant votre Main Phase. Tous les monstres Machine que vous contrôlez ne sont pas affectés par les effets de Magie de votre adversaire. Vous pouvez Invoquer Normalement les Monstres Normaux Machine avec 1 Sacrifice en moins. Si un monstre non-Machine est dans votre Cimetière, retournez cette Compétence. Cette Compétence ne peut être utilisée qu'une fois par Duel.
300103002.desc_en:
[Activate this Skill during your Main Phase.] 

All Machine monsters you control are unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects. You can Normal Summon Machine Normal Monsters with 1 less Tribute. If a non-Machine monster is in your GY, flip this Skill over. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

300103003.desc_fr: Si vous avez max. 1500 LP, activez cette Compétence. Prenez le contrôle d'1 carte Posée dans la Zone Magie & Piège de votre adversaire. Cette Compétence ne peut être utilisée qu'une fois par Duel.
300103003.desc_en: If your LP are 1500 or less, activate this Skill. Take control of 1 Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

300103004.desc_fr: Une fois par tour, vous pouvez envoyer 1 Monstre Normal Zombie de max. Niveau 3 depuis votre Deck au Cimetière.
300103004.desc_en: Once per turn, you can send 1 Level 3 or lower Zombie Normal Monster from your Deck to the GY.

300103005.desc_en: At the start of your Draw Phase, instead of drawing a card, you can pay 1500 LP to activate this Skill. Banish 1 Dinosaur monster and 1 non-Dinosaur monster from your hand and/or GY; Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Dinosaur monster from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

300104001.desc_en:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can choose 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie monster you control, and it gains the following effect while face-up on the field.
● Once per turn: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie monster in either GY; Special Summon that target. This monster must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

300104002.desc_fr: Activez cette Compétence durant votre Main Phase, tant que vous contrôlez "Kairyu-Shin". Lorsque cette Compétence est activée, vous pouvez activer "Umi" directement depuis votre main, Deck ou Cimetière. Tant que vous contrôlez "Kairyu-Shin", tous les monstres EAU que vous contrôlez ne sont pas affectés par des effets de Piège. Si "Kairyu-Shin" que vous contrôlez quitte le Terrain, piochez 2 cartes, et si vous le faites, retournez cette carte.
300104002.desc_en: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase, while you control "Kairyu-Shin". When this Skill is activated, you can activate "Umi" directly from your hand, Deck or GY. While you control "Kairyu-Shin", all WATER monsters you control are unaffected by Trap effects. If "Kairyu-Shin" you control leaves the field, draw 2 cards, and if you do, flip this card over.

300104003.desc_fr: Activez cette Compétence durant votre Main Phase. Une fois par tour, vous pouvez choisir 1 monstre Dinosaure de min. Niveau 6 que vous contrôlez. Ce tour, s'il attaque un monstre en Position de Défense, infligez des dommages de combat perçants. Retournez cette carte à la fin du tour où vous avez activé cette Compétence.
300104003.desc_en: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per turn, you can choose 1 Level 6 or higher Dinosaur monster you control. This turn, if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. Flip this card over at the end of the turn you activated this Skill.

300104004.desc_en:
Activate the following Skill(s) during your Main Phase.
● You can Tribute 1 Insect monster from either field equipped with an Equip Card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Insect monster from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, also flip this card over.
● You can shuffle 1 Insect monster from your GY into the Deck, then draw 1 card, also flip this card over.
Each of these Skills can only be used once per Duel.

300104005.desc_fr: Activez cette Compétence durant votre Main Phase. Une fois par tour, vous pouvez mélanger 1 carte depuis votre main dans le Deck, puis piochez 1 carte, et aussi, retournez cette carte. Vous pouvez utiliser cette Compétence max. deux fois par Duel.
300104005.desc_en: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per turn, you can shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, then draw 1 card, also flip this card over. You can use this Skill up to twice per Duel.

300201001.desc_fr: Tous les monstres Démon et Magicien sur le Terrain gagnent 200 ATK/DEF, et aussi, tous les monstres Elfe sur le terrain perdent 200 ATK/DEF.
300201001.desc_en:
[At the start of the Duel, place this card in your Field Spell Zone and flip it over.] 

All Fiend and Spellcaster monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF, also all Fairy monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF.

300201002.desc_en:
[If you lose 2000 or more LP, you can activate this Skill during your next Draw Phase.]

During your Draw Phase, you may search your Deck for any card, reveal it to your opponent, and add it to your hand instead of drawing. If you do that, flip this card over.

300201003.desc_fr:
Activez cette Compétence durant votre Main Phase.
Une fois par tour, durant votre tour, vous pouvez placer un Compteur sur cette Compétence. Si elle a min. 3 Compteurs lorsque vous allez piocher une carte, vous pouvez chercher une carte dans votre Deck et l'ajouter à votre main à la place. A la fin du tour où vous utilisez cette Compétence, vous perdez le Duel.
300201003.desc_en:
[Activate this Skill during your Main Phase] 

Once per turn, during your turn, you may place a counter on this Skill. If it has 3 or more counters when you would draw a card, you may search your Deck for any card and add it to your hand instead. At the end of the turn you use this Skill, you lose the Duel.

300201004.desc_fr:
Si les LP de votre adversaire sont supérieurs au double des vôtres, activez cette Compétence.
Vous pouvez regarder la carte du dessus de votre Deck ainsi que celle du Deck de votre adversaire à tout moment.
300201004.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.]

If your opponent's LP is more than twice your LP, activate this Skill.
You may look at the top card of both your and your opponent's Deck at any time.

300201005.desc_fr:
Si vous perdez min. 1800 LP, vous pouvez activer cette Compétence durant votre prochaine Draw Phase.
Durant votre Draw Phase, vous pouvez chercher une carte "Protecteurs du Tombeau" dans votre Deck, révélez-la à votre adversaire, et ajoutez-la à votre main au lieu de piocher. Si vous faites ça, retournez cette carte.
300201005.desc_en:
[If you lose 1800 or more LP, you can activate this Skill during your next Draw Phase.]

During your Draw Phase, you may search your Deck for a “Gravekeeper’s” card, reveal it to your opponent, and add it to your hand instead of drawing. If you do that, flip this card over.

300201006.desc_fr:
Au début du tour de l'adversaire, avant qu'il pioche, vous pouvez regarder les 3 cartes du dessus de son Deck et les réarranger dans l'ordre de votre choix.
Cette compétence ne peut être utilisée qu'une fois par Duel.
300201006.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.] 

At the start of the opponent’s turn, before they draw, you may look at the top 3 cards of their Deck and rearrange them in any order.
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

300201007.desc_fr: Activez cette carte en payant 1000 LP.
300201007.desc_en:
[At the start of the Duel, place this card in your center Spell & Trap Zone and flip it over.]

This card is treated as “Toon World”.

300201008.desc_fr:
Au début du 3e tour (comptez les tours de chaque joueur), si vos LP sont min. 3000, activez cette Compétence.
Vous pouvez regarder les Cartes Magie/Piège Posées de votre adversaire à tout moment. Si vos LP passent en dessous de 3000, retournez cette carte.
300201008.desc_en:
[At the start of the 3rd turn, if your LP is 3000 or higher, activate this Skill (count both players' turns).]

You may look at your opponent's Set Spell & Trap Cards at anytime. If your LP drops below 3000, flip this card over.

300201009.desc_fr: Au début du Duel, regardez la main du début de votre adversaire. Vous pouvez choisir de faire mélanger au joueur sa main dans son Deck et de piocher une nouvelle main. (Si chaque joueur utilise une Compétence en même temps, le joueur du tour résout sa Compétence en premier.)
300201009.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.]

At the start of the Duel, look at your opponent’s opening hand. You may choose to have that player shuffle their hand into their Deck and draw a new hand. (If both players use a Skill at the same time, the Turn player resolves their Skill first.)

300202001.desc_fr: Tous les monstres Dragon, Bête Ailée et Tonnerre sur le Terrain gagnent 200 ATK/DEF.
300202001.desc_en:
[At the start of the Duel, place this card in your Field Spell Zone and flip it over.] 

All Dragon, Winged Beast, and Thunder monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

300202002.desc_fr:
Si vous contrôlez un monstre de min. Niveau 5, vous pouvez activer cette Compétence.
Tous les monstres que vous contrôlez actuellement gagnent 300 ATK pour chaque monstre de min. Niveau 5 que vous contrôlez. A la fin de votre tour, retournez cette carte.
300202002.desc_en:
[If you control a Level 5 or higher monster, you can activate this Skill.]

All monsters you currently control gain 300 ATK for each Level 5 or higher monster you control. At the end of your turn, flip this card over.

300202003.desc_fr:
Une fois par Duel, vous pouvez utiliser une des Compétences suivantes.
● Si vous Invoquez Normalement "Seigneur des D." avec succès, ajoutez 1 "La Flûte d'Invocation du Dragon" depuis votre Deck ou Cimetière à votre main.
● Révélez "La Flûte d'Invocation du Dragon" depuis votre main, puis ajoutez 1 "Seigneur des D." depuis votre Deck ou Cimetière à votre main.
300202003.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.] 

Once per Duel, you can use 1 of the following Skills.
• If you successfully Normal Summon “Lord of D.”, add 1 “The Flute of Summoning Dragon” from your Deck or GY to your hand.
• Reveal “The Flute of Summoning Dragon” from your hand, then add 1 “Lord of D.” from your Deck or GY to your hand.

300202004.desc_fr: Au début de votre tour, dites 2 nombres et lancez un dé à six faces. Si le résultat de votre lancer correspond à l'un des nombres dits, vos LP ne passent pas en dessous de 1 jusqu'à la fin du prochain tour de votre adversaire. Cette Compétence ne peut être utilisée qu'une fois par Duel.
300202004.desc_en:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.] 

At the start of your turn, call 2 numbers and roll a six-sided die. If you roll a number you called, your LP do not get lower than 1 until the end of your opponent's next turn. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

300202005.desc_fr:
Au début du 5e tour (comptez les tours de chaque joueur), activez cette Compétence.
Durant votre Main Phase, vous pouvez réduire vos LP à 100, et défaussez 2 cartes depuis votre main. Lancez un dé à 6 faces et piochez un nombre de cartes égal au résultat. Cette Compétence ne peut être utilisée qu'une fois par Duel.
300202005.desc_en:
[At the start of the 5th turn, activate this Skill (count both players' turns).]

During your Main Phase, you can reduce your LP to 100 and discard 2 cards from your hand. Roll a six-sided die and draw cards equal to the result. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

300202006.desc_fr: Durant votre tour, vous pouvez révéler 1 Monstre Normal dans votre main. Ce tour, le monstre peut être utilisé à la place d'1 Matériel Fusion. Si vous le faites, les autres Matériels Fusion doivent être corrects. Cette Compétence ne peut être utilisée qu'une fois par Duel.
300202006.desc_en:
